Hi All,

I’ve published 3 infinite countermodels for Equational Theories, with their Lean files. Some of you may have seen these results in the SAiR math distillation challenge.

E11116 ⇏ E28770
E40909 ⇏ E28770
E48799 ⇏ E51430

The first two are infinite term models and the third uses 2 copies of ℕ. :pirate_flag:

I also formalized a related result :

  • a specific order-6 law (A6) is equivalent to E11116 for every magma. As a result, the first model also witnesses A6 ⇏ E28770. The reverse direction of that equivalence is proved and it does not rely on assuming that every element is a product.

The files are here: https://github.com/Axabra/order-five-infinite-countermodels

Enjoy ! :innocent:
